## Review checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria are met.
- [ ] One accountable owner is recorded for each task.
- [ ] Changes stay within the owned file/module scope.
- [ ] API contracts were agreed before parallel work, if applicable.
- [ ] Tests were written and run where code changed.
- [ ] Evidence is attached for every verification claim.
- [ ] Documentation is consistent with the delivered behavior.
- [ ] Review findings are resolved with evidence.
